combo_label: Things That Beep × Birds & Birdwatching × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Stiff-winged northern seabird tribe taking in the razorbill and the guillemot
Kitchen rumbler that clicks, chirps, and refuses to boil while you watch it.
Slim projection at a wall's corner, housing a lookout or a spiral stair
Water-filled ditch that made scaling ladders useless and tunnelling a drowning risk
Tenth of the harvest owed to the parish, stored in a barn built for it
Sheltered thicket or ledge where birds pack in shoulder to shoulder for the night
Barrier arm that bleeps you through, or barks if your ticket is stale
Box that dings at each floor while playing music nobody has ever hummed
Small falcon hanging motionless above a verge, scanning the grass for voles
Hole in the wall that beeps in a panic until you remember to take your card.
